text:
Sam H: Heads-up: scheduling a config-only rollout now — targets: routing policy (route weights), per-tenant ratefloor, and batching window. Change window 12:00–12:30 PT. Canary 5% -> 25% -> 100%. @Jordan P @Maria L please ack. Deploy-bot will run the canary.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: starting canary for config 'ratefloor-v2' (config-only) on eng-release-configs at 1728420001. Canary size: 5%.

Jordan P: Ack. I'll watch latency dashboards and p99 per-route. Any explicit rollback thresholds? cpu/KV cache pressure?

Maria L: Suggest rollback if p50 > 220ms OR error-rate +0.3% vs baseline for 5m. Also rollback if kv cache evictions spike >2x.

Sam H: Agree on thresholds. Also adding model-version fallback mapping for routing: 'redwood/fast-v2' -> fallback 'fast-v1' in the release notes. No code changes.

Ethan R: Made a conservative bump to batching window in the canary (16ms -> 28ms) to smooth tail. Snippet: 
```
batch.window_ms=28
batch.max_tokens=512
route.weights=[0.95,0.05]
```

Jordan P: Noted. I'll keep an eye on per-route p99 and queue depth. @opsbot can we mute noise for minor spikes during the canary?

opsbot: opsbot: alerts muted for routing-* for 30m per request from Sam H.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary (5%) healthy at +6m. No errors detected in canary slice. Proceeding to 25%.

Maria L: Seeing a small p50 increase (~+15ms), p99 stable, kv evictions normal. LGTM to continue to 25%.

Sam H: Rolling to 25% now. Reminder: config-only, no model binaries. If anyone wants rollback, reply with 'rollback' and tag.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout to 25% complete at 1728420115.

Jordan P: Traffic shaping looks stable overall. Dashboard: https://dashboards.internal/route-latency?canary=1728420001

Ethan R: Noting one tenant (acme-inc) at 25% with elevated tail latency. Investigating. Temporarily pinning that tenant back to previous weights until root cause identified.

Sam H: Good catch. Perform a partial rollback for that tenant. Deploy-bot, pin routing for tenant 'acme-inc' back to previous weights (0.8/0.2). Note in changelog.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: pinned routing for tenant 'acme-inc' to previous weights (0.8/0.2). Action logged.

Maria L: After pinned rollback, metrics for other tenants look stable. No systemic regressions. Proposal: proceed to 100% after 10m stable at 25%.

Jordan P: +1.

Sam H: Proceeding to 100% in 10m if stable. Opsbot, please ensure alerts are unmuted afterwards.

opsbot: opsbot: will unmute alerts at 1728420720 per schedule.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout to 100% completed at 1728420180. Release note summary: 'config-only: per-tenant ratefloor update, batching window increased to 28ms, route fallback mapping added; partial tenant pin applied for acme-inc during rollout.'

Sam H: Thanks everyone. I'll publish release notes in the docs repo and tag the config commit. If any follow-ups, open a postmortem thread.
